name: warden-mcp
description: Connects Claude to the agent access of a Warden DNS filter: adds the token, pins the certificate fingerprint and forwards MCP messages unchanged.

warden_url.title: Warden URL
warden_url.description: WARDEN_URL from the block that warden credential add printed, such as https://192.0.2.10:8443/mcp

warden_token.title: Warden token
warden_token.description: WARDEN_TOKEN from the block that warden credential add printed

warden_tls_sha256.title: Certificate fingerprint
warden_tls_sha256.description: WARDEN_TLS_SHA256: the fingerprint that warden agent cert show prints on the Warden host; needed for an https URL
